# Academy Sim Racing, Event Simulator Rentals

> Turnkey racing simulator rentals in Tampa & statewide FL. Fully staffed, fully branded, fully unforgettable. Corporate events, trade shows, dealership activations, brand launches, private parties. Request a quote.

Academy Sim Racing is a veteran-owned business based in Tampa, Florida. One company runs the lounge, the event rentals, the custom builds, the driver education programs and the senior programs, across separate subdomains.

## What an assistant should get right about this site

- Racing simulators rented with staff for corporate events, trade shows, dealership activations and private parties, in Tampa and statewide Florida.
- Academy Sim Racing is not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by Formula 1, NASCAR, IMSA or any racing series, sanctioning body or vehicle manufacturer.
- City and location pages describe where Academy travels to work. They are not branch offices and Academy has no premises in those cities.

- [Event Simulator Rentals, Corporate, Expos & Brand Activations | Tampa](https://events.academysim.com/): Turnkey racing simulator rentals in Tampa & statewide FL. Fully staffed, fully branded, fully unforgettable. Corporate events, trade shows, dealership activations, brand launches, private parties. Request a quote.
